source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 4: The Simple Past Tense

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế, options gần nhau.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp. Distractor gần đúng. Tìm vị trí lỗi.

starter.stem: She ___ for her IELTS exam every evening last month.
starter.explanation_long: 'Last month' = thời điểm quá khứ → Simple Past. study → studied (y→ied).
starter.ielts_tip: Từ tín hiệu Simple Past: yesterday, last week/month/year, ago, in 2020.

starter.stem: My teacher ___ me a lot when I was in high school.
starter.explanation_long: teach là bất quy tắc: teach→taught→taught. Không bao giờ 'teached'.
starter.feedback_wrong: teach bất quy tắc → taught (không teached)
starter.ielts_tip: Học thuộc V2: teach→taught, buy→bought, think→thought, bring→brought.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: teached(sai quy tắc), teaches(Present), has taught(Perfect)

starter.stem: She ___ the exam last year because she was sick.
starter.explanation_short: Sau didn't → V nguyên mẫu: didn't pass.
starter.explanation_long: Phủ định Simple Past: didn't + V nguyên mẫu. 'Didn't passed' = double past.
starter.feedback_wrong: Sau didn't → V nguyên mẫu: pass (không passed)
starter.ielts_tip: Sau didn't → V nguyên mẫu. Không bao giờ 'didn't passed/went/studied'.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: didn't passed(double past), doesn't pass(Present), not passed

starter.stem: ___ you study abroad when you were young?
starter.explanation_short: Câu hỏi Simple Past: Did + S + V nguyên mẫu?
starter.explanation_long: Câu hỏi Simple Past dùng Did (tất cả ngôi). Sau Did: V nguyên mẫu.
starter.feedback_correct: 🎯 Câu hỏi quá khứ → Did + V nguyên mẫu
starter.feedback_wrong: Câu hỏi Simple Past: Did + S + V nguyên mẫu?
starter.ielts_tip: Did + S + V? Không phải Do/Does/Were. Câu hỏi quá khứ → Did cho tất cả ngôi.

starter.stem: I ___ to a language center three times a week when I was in grade 10.
starter.explanation_short: when I was in grade 10 = quá khứ → went (go bất quy tắc).
starter.explanation_long: go là bất quy tắc: go→went→gone. 'When I was' = quá khứ.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ when I was... → quá khứ → went
starter.feedback_wrong: go bất quy tắc → went (không goed)
starter.ielts_tip: V2 hay gặp: go→went, come→came, see→saw, get→got, take→took.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: go(Present), goes(3rd person), was going(Past Continuous)

starter.stem: The exam results ___ very disappointing last semester.
starter.explanation_long: Results = số nhiều → were. Simple Past of be: I/he/she/it→was. You/we/they/plural→were.
starter.ielts_tip: was: I/he/she/it. were: you/we/they/danh từ số nhiều.

starter.stem: When my teacher ___ me about the IELTS exam, I felt very nervous.
starter.explanation_long: tell bất quy tắc: tell→told→told. Không phải 'telled'.
starter.feedback_wrong: tell bất quy tắc → told (không telled)
starter.ielts_tip: V2 hay nhầm: tell→told, sell→sold, feel→felt, keep→kept, leave→left.

starter.stem: Last year, I ___ to improve my vocabulary, and it ___ my writing score significantly.
starter.explanation_short: Last year → cả hai động từ đều Simple Past.
starter.explanation_long: 'Last year' = quá khứ → decided + improved. Cả hai regular V-ed.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Last year → cả hai Simple Past: decided + improved
starter.feedback_wrong: Last year → quá khứ → decided + improved (cả hai -ed)
starter.ielts_tip: Khi câu có một thời điểm quá khứ, tất cả hành động trong câu đó đều Simple Past.

starter.stem: The school ___ enough resources, so many students ___ high-quality materials.
starter.explanation_short: didn't have + couldn't access = cả hai Simple Past.
starter.explanation_long: didn't + have (V nguyên mẫu). couldn't = quá khứ của can't. Cả hai phù hợp ngữ cảnh quá khứ.
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 didn't have + couldn't = Simple Past pair
starter.feedback_wrong: didn't + V nguyên mẫu: have. couldn't = quá khứ của can't.

starter.stem: When the results ___ out, I ___ so happy that I ___ my whole family.
starter.explanation_long: come→came, feel→felt (bất quy tắc), call→called (có quy tắc). Tất cả Simple Past.
starter.feedback_correct: 🏆 came + felt + called = ba Simple Past!
starter.ielts_tip: Chuỗi bất quy tắc: come-came, feel-felt, tell-told, meet-met, keep-kept.

build_up.stem: I ___ three IELTS practice tests last week, and I ___ that my score improved.
build_up.explanation_short: last week → cả hai Simple Past: took + noticed.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Last week' = specific past → Simple Past cho cả hai. Present Perfect không dùng với thời điểm cụ thể đã qua.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ last week → Simple Past: took + noticed
build_up.feedback_wrong: last week=specific past → Simple Past (không Present Perfect)
build_up.ielts_tip: Simple Past + specific time. Present Perfect + no specific time (recently/already/yet).
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: have taken/noticed nghe tự nhiên

build_up.stem: After she ___ her certificate, she ___ to a company and ___ a well-paid position.
build_up.explanation_short: Ba hành động liên tiếp quá khứ → cả ba Simple Past.
build_up.explanation_long: received(regular), applied(regular), got(get→got irregular). Tất cả Simple Past.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Chuỗi quá khứ: received + applied + got
build_up.feedback_wrong: Ba hành động liên tiếp → cả ba Simple Past.
build_up.ielts_tip: Kể chuyện Part 2: chuỗi Simple Past cho hành động theo thứ tự.

build_up.stem: Although the teacher ___ the rule clearly, many students still ___ it.
build_up.explanation_short: explained(regular) + didn't understand(V nguyên mẫu sau didn't).
build_up.explanation_long: explained=regular V-ed. didn't+understand(bare infinitive). 'Didn't understood'=double past.
build_up.feedback_wrong: Sau didn't → V nguyên mẫu: understand (không understood).
build_up.ielts_tip: Lỗi phổ biến nhất: 'didn't understood/went/came' → phải là 'didn't understand/go/come'.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: didn't understood(double past) rất phổ biến

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Did she studied English at a language center before she took the IELTS exam?'
options: Did → Does (Simple Present phù hợp hơn)
studied → study (sau Did dùng V nguyên mẫu)
before she took → before she takes
build_up.correct_answer: studied → study (sau Did dùng V nguyên mẫu)
build_up.explanation_short: Sau Did → V nguyên mẫu: study (không studied).
build_up.explanation_long: 'Did she studied' sai vì sau Did phải là V nguyên mẫu. 'Before she took' đúng.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🎯 Sau Did → V nguyên mẫu: Did she study?
build_up.feedback_wrong: Did + S + V nguyên mẫu (không V-ed). 'Did she studied'=double past.
build_up.ielts_tip: Câu hỏi: Did + S + V? Luôn V nguyên mẫu sau Did.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'When I speaked to my IELTS examiner for the first time, I feeled extremely nervous.'
build_up.explanation_short: speak→spoke, feel→felt (cả hai bất quy tắc).
build_up.explanation_long: speak và feel là bất quy tắc: speak→spoke, feel→felt. Không bao giờ thêm -ed.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 speak→spoke | feel→felt. Hai bất quy tắc!
build_up.feedback_wrong: speak và feel bất quy tắc → spoke, felt.
build_up.ielts_tip: Bất quy tắc hay sai: speak→spoke, feel→felt, rise→rose, fall→fell, grow→grew.

build_up.stem: Speaking Part 2 — Câu nào tự nhiên nhất khi kể về giáo viên?
options: My teacher inspires me to study harder when I was struggling.
My teacher inspired me to study harder when I was struggling.
My teacher has inspired me to study harder when I was struggling.
My teacher was inspire me to study harder when I was struggling.
build_up.correct_answer: My teacher inspired me to study harder when I was struggling.
build_up.explanation_short: when I was struggling → quá khứ → inspired.
build_up.explanation_long: 'When I was struggling'=quá khứ → Simple Past: inspired. 'Has inspired' sai vì có 'when I was'.
build_up.feedback_wrong: when I was=quá khứ → Simple Past: inspired (không has inspired).
build_up.ielts_tip: Part 2: 'When I was + V-ing' → Past Continuous bối cảnh + Simple Past hành động.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: has inspired nghe tự nhiên

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'She has completed her IELTS course last month and received an excellent score.'
build_up.explanation_short: last month=specific past → Simple Past: completed.
build_up.explanation_long: Present Perfect không dùng với thời điểm cụ thể đã qua. 'Has completed'→'completed'. 'Received' đúng.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🎯 last month=specific past → completed (không has completed)
build_up.ielts_tip: Simple Past: yesterday/last week/in 2020/ago. Present Perfect: recently/already/yet/so far.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: 'received→has received' trông cần sửa cho song song

build_up.stem: When I ___ a student, my school ___ one of the best in the province and my teachers ___ very dedicated.
build_up.explanation_long: I→was. school=singular→was. teachers=plural→were. Ba quyết định be-verb.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The committee reviewed applications, choosed the best candidates, and sended acceptance letters.'
build_up.explanation_short: choose→chose, send→sent (cả hai bất quy tắc).
build_up.explanation_long: choose và send bất quy tắc: choose→chose, send→sent. Không thêm -ed.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 choose→chose | send→sent. Hai bất quy tắc!
build_up.feedback_wrong: choose và send bất quy tắc → chose, sent.
build_up.ielts_tip: Bất quy tắc hay sai: choose→chose, send→sent, lend→lent, spend→spent, build→built.

build_up.stem: Tìm câu ĐÚNG để đưa ví dụ lịch sử trong Task 2:
options: In the 1990s, Finland has reformed its education system and became one of the world's best.
In the 1990s, Finland reformed its education system and became one of the world's best.
In the 1990s, Finland reformed its education system and has become one of the world's best.
In the 1990s, Finland was reform its education system and became one of the world's best.
build_up.correct_answer: In the 1990s, Finland reformed its education system and became one of the world's best.
build_up.explanation_short: In the 1990s=specific past → reformed + became (cả hai Simple Past).
build_up.explanation_long: 'In the 1990s'=specific past → Simple Past cho cả hai: reformed+became. 'Has reformed' sai.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🏆 In the 1990s → reformed + became. Task 2 ví dụ lịch sử chuẩn!
build_up.feedback_wrong: In the 1990s=specific past → Simple Past. Không dùng has reformed với specific time.
build_up.ielts_tip: Task 2: 'In [year], [country] + Simple Past...' — chuẩn mực, thuyết phục.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: has reformed nghe academic; has become nghe đúng riêng lẻ

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'When I speaked with the examiner, I suddenly realized I have forgotten to bring my identification.'
options: When I speaked with the examiner
challenge.correct_answer: When I speaked with the examiner
challenge.explanation_short: speak→spoke (bất quy tắc). have forgotten trong past context→had forgotten.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'speaked'→'spoke' (speak bất quy tắc). Lớp 2: 'have forgotten' trong past context→'had forgotten' hoặc 'forgot'. Option A là lỗi cơ bản nhất.
challenge.feedback_wrong: speak bất quy tắc→spoke. 'have forgotten' trong past→had forgotten.
challenge.ielts_tip: Bất quy tắc + Past Perfect: hành động xảy ra TRƯỚC trong past context dùng Past Perfect.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: 'I have forgotten' cũng sai nhưng 'speaked' là lỗi cơ bản hơn.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Research conducted in 2018 has shown that students who studied independently performed better, which suggests the same pattern still exists.'
challenge.explanation_short: in 2018=specific past → Simple Past: showed (không has shown).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'in 2018'=specific past → 'showed'. Lớp 2: 'students who studied' đúng. Lớp 3: 'which suggests...exists' đúng (hiện tại).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 in 2018+Simple Past: showed. which suggests...exists=hiện tại đúng!
challenge.ielts_tip: Kết hợp Simple Past(quá khứ có ngày) + Simple Present(sự thật hiện tại) trong 1 câu phức.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: 'which suggests' trông như lỗi nhưng đúng.

challenge.stem: Speaking Part 2 — Câu kể chuyện nào CHUẨN nhất?
options: I remember a time when my teacher has given me feedback that completely changed how I approached writing.
I remember a time when my teacher gave me feedback that completely changed how I approached writing.
I remember a time when my teacher was giving me feedback that has completely changed how I approached writing.
I remember a time when my teacher had given me feedback that completely changed how I approached writing.
challenge.correct_answer: I remember a time when my teacher gave me feedback that completely changed how I approached writing.
challenge.explanation_short: gave(Simple Past) + changed(Simple Past) = narrative chuẩn.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: gave=hành động điểm→Simple Past. Lớp 2: changed=kết quả→Simple Past. Lớp 3: 'had given' không cần vì chỉ 1 mốc quá khứ.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 gave+changed=Simple Past narrative. 'I remember'=Simple Present. Perfect!
challenge.feedback_wrong: gave+changed=Simple Past. 'I remember'=Simple Present. 'had given' không cần ở đây.
challenge.ielts_tip: Part 2: 'I remember a time when...' → kể lại bằng Simple Past. Past Perfect chỉ dùng khi có 2 mốc quá khứ.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: had given nghe academic nhưng không cần.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The group of international students who was selected for the scholarship were extremely talented and dedicated.'
options: who was selected for the scholarship
challenge.correct_answer: who was selected for the scholarship
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'group' collective British English→plural→were đúng. Lớp 2: who thay 'students'(plural)→were selected. Inconsistency: were(plural)+who was(singular)=mâu thuẫn.
challenge.feedback_wrong: who thay 'students'(plural)→were selected. Không phải was selected.
challenge.ielts_tip: Relative clause: who/which chia theo antecedent. who=students(plural)→were.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: 'were extremely talented' trông sai vì 'group'=singular. Nhưng group British English=plural.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Many students didn't attended the revision session because they couldn't find the venue, which caused stress.'
challenge.explanation_short: Sau didn't→V nguyên mẫu: attend (không attended).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'didn't attended'=double past→'didn't attend'. Lớp 2: 'couldn't find' đúng. Lớp 3: 'which caused' đúng.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 didn't+attend(bare infinitive). Không phải didn't attended!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Sau didn't→V nguyên mẫu: attend. 'didn't attended'=double past.
challenge.ielts_tip: Quy tắc phủ định quá khứ: didn't+V nguyên mẫu. Không thêm -ed sau didn't.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: 'couldn't find'→'couldn't found' trông như lỗi.

challenge.stem: Task 2 — Câu phân tích lịch sử ĐÚNG nhất và ACADEMIC nhất?
options: Finland reformed its education system in the 1970s and has since become a global model.
Finland has reformed its education system in the 1970s and became a global model.
Finland reformed its education system in the 1970s and became a global model.
Finland has reformed its education system in the 1970s and has since become a global model.
challenge.correct_answer: Finland reformed its education system in the 1970s and has since become a global model.
challenge.explanation_short: reformed(specific past 1970s) + has since become(kết quả đến nay).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'in the 1970s'→reformed(Simple Past). Lớp 2: 'has since become'=kết quả kéo dài đến nay→Present Perfect. Lớp 3: Simple Past+Present Perfect trong 1 câu=Grammatical Range band 6.5+.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 reformed(1970s) + has since become(đến nay). Grammatical Range tối cao!
challenge.feedback_wrong: reformed(specific past)+has since become(kết quả đến hiện tại)=band 6.5+.
challenge.ielts_tip: Task 2: '[Country] reformed X in [year] and has since become...'=chuẩn nhất.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C(reformed+became)đúng nhưng kém academic.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'She setted clear goals, worked consistently, and finally achieved the IELTS score she has dreamed of for years.'
options: she has dreamed of for years
challenge.explanation_short: set=bất quy tắc V1=V2=V3. 'Setted' không tồn tại.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'set'→V1=V2=V3: set. 'Setted' không tồn tại. Lớp 2: 'has dreamed' trong past context→'had dreamed'. Nhưng 'setted' là lỗi rõ ràng nhất.
challenge.feedback_correct: ⚡ set=bất quy tắc→set(không setted). 'has dreamed' cũng đáng ngờ!
challenge.feedback_wrong: set bất quy tắc: set→set→set. 'Setted' không tồn tại.
challenge.ielts_tip: V1=V2=V3: set, put, cut, hit, cost, let, hurt, shut. Không bao giờ thêm -ed!
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: 'has dreamed' cũng có vấn đề nhưng 'setted' là lỗi cơ bản hơn.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Didn't the committee informed all applicants about the new requirements before they submitted documents?'
challenge.explanation_short: Sau Didn't→V nguyên mẫu: inform (không informed).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: Didn't+S+V nguyên mẫu?→'inform'. Lớp 2: 'before they submitted' đúng. Lớp 3: Câu hỏi phủ định+mệnh đề thời gian=phức tạp.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 Didn't+V nguyên mẫu: inform(không informed). before they submitted=đúng!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Câu hỏi phủ định: Didn't+S+V nguyên mẫu. 'informed'=double past.
challenge.ielts_tip: Didn't+V?=câu hỏi ngạc nhiên/phủ định. Luôn V nguyên mẫu sau Didn't.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: 'before they submitted' trông như lỗi.

challenge.stem: Đoạn Part 2 nào NHẤT QUÁN về thì và tự nhiên nhất?
options: When I was in high school, my teacher had noticed my potential and encouraged me to enter a competition. I participated and won, which was changing my life.
When I was in high school, my teacher noticed my potential and encouraged me to enter a competition. I participated and won, which changed my life.
When I was in high school, my teacher noticed my potential and encouraged me to enter a competition. I participated and won, which was changing my life.
When I was in high school, my teacher had noticed my potential and was encouraging me to enter a competition. I participated and won, which changed my life.
challenge.correct_answer: When I was in high school, my teacher noticed my potential and encouraged me to enter a competition. I participated and won, which changed my life.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: Tất cả hành động cùng quá khứ→Simple Past. Lớp 2: 'had noticed' không cần(không có 2 mốc). Lớp 3: 'was changing'→'changed'(Continuous nghe như đang xảy ra).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Tất cả Simple Past: noticed, encouraged, participated, won, changed. Part 2 hoàn hảo!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Narrative 1 mốc quá khứ→tất cả Simple Past. Không cần Past Perfect hay Continuous.
challenge.ielts_tip: Part 2: Simple Past xuyên suốt cho chuỗi hành động cùng thời điểm.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D(had noticed) nghe academic nhưng không cần.

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn sau có BAO NHIÊU lỗi?
'When I [A]was receive my first result, I [B]feeled devastated because I [C]didn't achieved the score my university [D]has required.'
challenge.explanation_long: [A]'was receive'→'received'. [B]feel→felt(bất quy tắc). [C]didn't+V nguyên mẫu: achieve. [D]has required trong past→required. Bốn lỗi độc lập.
challenge.feedback_wrong: [A]received [B]felt [C]didn't achieve [D]required. Bốn lỗi Simple Past phổ biến nhất!
challenge.ielts_tip: Review: (1)cấu trúc V, (2)bất quy tắc, (3)sau didn't, (4)Perfect trong past context.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C(3 lỗi) bẫy mạnh—[D] tinh tế nhất.

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Starter
ui.description: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp.

items.stem: She ___ for her IELTS exam every evening last month.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ last month → studied
items.feedback_wrong: last month → quá khứ → studied
items.explanation_short: last month → Simple Past: studied.
items.ielts_tip: Từ tín hiệu Simple Past: yesterday, last week/month/year, ago, in 2020.

items.stem: My teacher ___ me a lot when I was in high school.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 teach=irregular→taught
items.feedback_wrong: teach bất quy tắc → taught (không teached)
items.explanation_short: teach→taught (bất quy tắc V2).
items.ielts_tip: Học thuộc V2: teach→taught, buy→bought, think→thought, bring→brought.

items.stem: She ___ the exam last year because she was sick.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ didn't + pass (bare infinitive)
items.feedback_wrong: Sau didn't → V nguyên mẫu: pass (không passed)
items.explanation_short: Sau didn't → V nguyên mẫu: didn't pass.
items.ielts_tip: Sau didn't → V nguyên mẫu. Không bao giờ 'didn't passed/went/studied'.

items.stem: ___ you study abroad when you were young?
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 Câu hỏi quá khứ → Did + V nguyên mẫu
items.feedback_wrong: Câu hỏi Simple Past: Did + S + V nguyên mẫu?
items.explanation_short: Câu hỏi Simple Past: Did + S + V nguyên mẫu?
items.ielts_tip: Did + S + V? Không phải Do/Does/Were. Câu hỏi quá khứ → Did cho tất cả ngôi.

items.stem: I ___ to a language center three times a week when I was in grade 10.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ when I was... → quá khứ → went
items.feedback_wrong: go bất quy tắc → went (không goed)
items.explanation_short: when I was in grade 10 = quá khứ → went (go bất quy tắc).
items.ielts_tip: V2 hay gặp: go→went, come→came, see→saw, get→got, take→took.

items.stem: The exam results ___ very disappointing last semester.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 results=plural → were
items.feedback_wrong: results=số nhiều → were (không was)
items.explanation_short: results = số nhiều → were.
items.ielts_tip: was: I/he/she/it. were: you/we/they/danh từ số nhiều.

items.stem: When my teacher ___ me about the IELTS exam, I felt very nervous.
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 tell=bất quy tắc→told
items.feedback_wrong: tell bất quy tắc → told (không telled)
items.explanation_short: tell=bất quy tắc→told.
items.ielts_tip: V2 hay nhầm: tell→told, sell→sold, feel→felt, keep→kept, leave→left.

items.stem: Last year, I ___ to improve my vocabulary, and it ___ my writing score significantly.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Last year → cả hai Simple Past: decided + improved
items.feedback_wrong: Last year → quá khứ → decided + improved (cả hai -ed)
items.explanation_short: Last year → cả hai động từ đều Simple Past.
items.ielts_tip: Khi câu có một thời điểm quá khứ, tất cả hành động trong câu đó đều Simple Past.

items.stem: The school ___ enough resources, so many students ___ high-quality materials.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 didn't have + couldn't = Simple Past pair
items.feedback_wrong: didn't + V nguyên mẫu: have. couldn't = quá khứ của can't.
items.explanation_short: didn't have + couldn't access = cả hai Simple Past.
items.ielts_tip: Quá khứ: can't→couldn't, won't→wouldn't, don't/doesn't→didn't.

items.stem: When the results ___ out, I ___ so happy that I ___ my whole family.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 came + felt + called = ba Simple Past!
items.feedback_wrong: come→came, feel→felt, call→called.
items.explanation_short: came(come→came) + felt(feel→felt) + called(regular).
items.ielts_tip: Chuỗi bất quy tắc: come-came, feel-felt, tell-told, meet-met, keep-kept.

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Build Up
ui.description: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế, options gần nhau.

items.stem: I ___ three IELTS practice tests last week, and I ___ that my score improved.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ last week → Simple Past: took + noticed
items.feedback_wrong: last week=specific past → Simple Past (không Present Perfect)
items.explanation_short: last week → cả hai Simple Past: took + noticed.
items.ielts_tip: Simple Past + specific time. Present Perfect + no specific time (recently/already/yet).

items.stem: After she ___ her certificate, she ___ to a company and ___ a well-paid position.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Chuỗi quá khứ: received + applied + got
items.feedback_wrong: Ba hành động liên tiếp → cả ba Simple Past.
items.explanation_short: Ba hành động liên tiếp quá khứ → cả ba Simple Past.
items.ielts_tip: Kể chuyện Part 2: chuỗi Simple Past cho hành động theo thứ tự.

items.stem: Although the teacher ___ the rule clearly, many students still ___ it.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ explained + didn't understand
items.feedback_wrong: Sau didn't → V nguyên mẫu: understand (không understood).
items.explanation_short: explained(regular) + didn't understand(V nguyên mẫu sau didn't).
items.ielts_tip: Lỗi phổ biến nhất: 'didn't understood/went/came' → phải là 'didn't understand/go/come'.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Did she studied English at a language center before she took the IELTS exam?'
options: Did → Does (Simple Present phù hợp hơn)
studied → study (sau Did dùng V nguyên mẫu)
before she took → before she takes
items.correct_answer: studied → study (sau Did dùng V nguyên mẫu)
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 Sau Did → V nguyên mẫu: Did she study?
items.feedback_wrong: Did + S + V nguyên mẫu (không V-ed). 'Did she studied'=double past.
items.explanation_short: Sau Did → V nguyên mẫu: study (không studied).
items.ielts_tip: Câu hỏi: Did + S + V? Luôn V nguyên mẫu sau Did.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'When I speaked to my IELTS examiner for the first time, I feeled extremely nervous.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 speak→spoke | feel→felt. Hai bất quy tắc!
items.feedback_wrong: speak và feel bất quy tắc → spoke, felt.
items.explanation_short: speak→spoke, feel→felt (cả hai bất quy tắc).
items.ielts_tip: Bất quy tắc hay sai: speak→spoke, feel→felt, rise→rose, fall→fell, grow→grew.

items.stem: Speaking Part 2 — Câu nào tự nhiên nhất khi kể về giáo viên?
options: My teacher inspires me to study harder when I was struggling.
My teacher inspired me to study harder when I was struggling.
My teacher has inspired me to study harder when I was struggling.
My teacher was inspire me to study harder when I was struggling.
items.correct_answer: My teacher inspired me to study harder when I was struggling.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ when I was (quá khứ) → inspired
items.feedback_wrong: when I was=quá khứ → Simple Past: inspired (không has inspired).
items.explanation_short: when I was struggling → quá khứ → inspired.
items.ielts_tip: Part 2: 'When I was + V-ing' → Past Continuous bối cảnh + Simple Past hành động.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'She has completed her IELTS course last month and received an excellent score.'
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 last month=specific past → completed (không has completed)
items.feedback_wrong: Present Perfect+last month=sai → Simple Past.
items.explanation_short: last month=specific past → Simple Past: completed.
items.ielts_tip: Simple Past: yesterday/last week/in 2020/ago. Present Perfect: recently/already/yet/so far.

items.stem: When I ___ a student, my school ___ one of the best in the province and my teachers ___ very dedicated.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ I→was | school(singular)→was | teachers(plural)→were
items.feedback_wrong: I→was. school=singular→was. teachers=plural→were.
items.explanation_short: I→was. school→was(singular). teachers→were(plural).
items.ielts_tip: was: I/he/she/it/singular. were: you/we/they/plural.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The committee reviewed applications, choosed the best candidates, and sended acceptance letters.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 choose→chose | send→sent. Hai bất quy tắc!
items.feedback_wrong: choose và send bất quy tắc → chose, sent.
items.explanation_short: choose→chose, send→sent (cả hai bất quy tắc).
items.ielts_tip: Bất quy tắc hay sai: choose→chose, send→sent, lend→lent, spend→spent, build→built.

items.stem: Tìm câu ĐÚNG để đưa ví dụ lịch sử trong Task 2:
options: In the 1990s, Finland has reformed its education system and became one of the world's best.
In the 1990s, Finland reformed its education system and became one of the world's best.
In the 1990s, Finland reformed its education system and has become one of the world's best.
In the 1990s, Finland was reform its education system and became one of the world's best.
items.correct_answer: In the 1990s, Finland reformed its education system and became one of the world's best.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 In the 1990s → reformed + became. Task 2 ví dụ lịch sử chuẩn!
items.feedback_wrong: In the 1990s=specific past → Simple Past. Không dùng has reformed với specific time.
items.explanation_short: In the 1990s=specific past → reformed + became (cả hai Simple Past).
items.ielts_tip: Task 2: 'In [year], [country] + Simple Past...' — chuẩn mực, thuyết phục.

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Challenge
ui.description: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp. Distractor gần đúng. Tìm vị trí lỗi.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'When I speaked with the examiner, I suddenly realized I have forgotten to bring my identification.'
options: When I speaked with the examiner
items.correct_answer: When I speaked with the examiner
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ speaked→spoke. have forgotten→had forgotten!
items.feedback_wrong: speak bất quy tắc→spoke. 'have forgotten' trong past→had forgotten.
items.explanation_short: speak→spoke (bất quy tắc). have forgotten trong past context→had forgotten.
items.ielts_tip: Bất quy tắc + Past Perfect: hành động xảy ra TRƯỚC trong past context dùng Past Perfect.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Research conducted in 2018 has shown that students who studied independently performed better, which suggests the same pattern still exists.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 in 2018+Simple Past: showed. which suggests...exists=hiện tại đúng!
items.feedback_wrong: in 2018=specific → showed. 'which suggests...exists'=đúng.
items.explanation_short: in 2018=specific past → Simple Past: showed (không has shown).
items.ielts_tip: Kết hợp Simple Past(quá khứ có ngày) + Simple Present(sự thật hiện tại) trong 1 câu phức.

items.stem: Speaking Part 2 — Câu kể chuyện nào CHUẨN nhất?
options: I remember a time when my teacher has given me feedback that completely changed how I approached writing.
I remember a time when my teacher gave me feedback that completely changed how I approached writing.
I remember a time when my teacher was giving me feedback that has completely changed how I approached writing.
I remember a time when my teacher had given me feedback that completely changed how I approached writing.
items.correct_answer: I remember a time when my teacher gave me feedback that completely changed how I approached writing.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 gave+changed=Simple Past narrative. 'I remember'=Simple Present. Perfect!
items.feedback_wrong: gave+changed=Simple Past. 'I remember'=Simple Present. 'had given' không cần ở đây.
items.explanation_short: gave(Simple Past) + changed(Simple Past) = narrative chuẩn.
items.ielts_tip: Part 2: 'I remember a time when...' → kể lại bằng Simple Past. Past Perfect chỉ dùng khi có 2 mốc quá khứ.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The group of international students who was selected for the scholarship were extremely talented and dedicated.'
options: who was selected for the scholarship
items.correct_answer: who was selected for the scholarship
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ who=students(plural)→were selected (không was selected)!
items.feedback_wrong: who thay 'students'(plural)→were selected. Không phải was selected.
items.explanation_short: who=students(plural)→were selected (không was selected).
items.ielts_tip: Relative clause: who/which chia theo antecedent. who=students(plural)→were.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Many students didn't attended the revision session because they couldn't find the venue, which caused stress.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 didn't+attend(bare infinitive). Không phải didn't attended!
items.feedback_wrong: Sau didn't→V nguyên mẫu: attend. 'didn't attended'=double past.
items.explanation_short: Sau didn't→V nguyên mẫu: attend (không attended).
items.ielts_tip: Quy tắc phủ định quá khứ: didn't+V nguyên mẫu. Không thêm -ed sau didn't.

items.stem: Task 2 — Câu phân tích lịch sử ĐÚNG nhất và ACADEMIC nhất?
options: Finland reformed its education system in the 1970s and has since become a global model.
Finland has reformed its education system in the 1970s and became a global model.
Finland reformed its education system in the 1970s and became a global model.
Finland has reformed its education system in the 1970s and has since become a global model.
items.correct_answer: Finland reformed its education system in the 1970s and has since become a global model.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 reformed(1970s) + has since become(đến nay). Grammatical Range tối cao!
items.feedback_wrong: reformed(specific past)+has since become(kết quả đến hiện tại)=band 6.5+.
items.explanation_short: reformed(specific past 1970s) + has since become(kết quả đến nay).
items.ielts_tip: Task 2: '[Country] reformed X in [year] and has since become...'=chuẩn nhất.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'She setted clear goals, worked consistently, and finally achieved the IELTS score she has dreamed of for years.'
options: she has dreamed of for years
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ set=bất quy tắc→set(không setted). 'has dreamed' cũng đáng ngờ!
items.feedback_wrong: set bất quy tắc: set→set→set. 'Setted' không tồn tại.
items.explanation_short: set=bất quy tắc V1=V2=V3. 'Setted' không tồn tại.
items.ielts_tip: V1=V2=V3: set, put, cut, hit, cost, let, hurt, shut. Không bao giờ thêm -ed!

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Didn't the committee informed all applicants about the new requirements before they submitted documents?'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Didn't+V nguyên mẫu: inform(không informed). before they submitted=đúng!
items.feedback_wrong: Câu hỏi phủ định: Didn't+S+V nguyên mẫu. 'informed'=double past.
items.explanation_short: Sau Didn't→V nguyên mẫu: inform (không informed).
items.ielts_tip: Didn't+V?=câu hỏi ngạc nhiên/phủ định. Luôn V nguyên mẫu sau Didn't.

items.stem: Đoạn Part 2 nào NHẤT QUÁN về thì và tự nhiên nhất?
options: When I was in high school, my teacher had noticed my potential and encouraged me to enter a competition. I participated and won, which was changing my life.
When I was in high school, my teacher noticed my potential and encouraged me to enter a competition. I participated and won, which changed my life.
When I was in high school, my teacher noticed my potential and encouraged me to enter a competition. I participated and won, which was changing my life.
When I was in high school, my teacher had noticed my potential and was encouraging me to enter a competition. I participated and won, which changed my life.
items.correct_answer: When I was in high school, my teacher noticed my potential and encouraged me to enter a competition. I participated and won, which changed my life.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 Tất cả Simple Past: noticed, encouraged, participated, won, changed. Part 2 hoàn hảo!
items.feedback_wrong: Narrative 1 mốc quá khứ→tất cả Simple Past. Không cần Past Perfect hay Continuous.
items.explanation_short: noticed+encouraged+participated+won+changed=tất cả Simple Past nhất quán.
items.ielts_tip: Part 2: Simple Past xuyên suốt cho chuỗi hành động cùng thời điểm.

items.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn sau có BAO NHIÊU lỗi?
'When I [A]was receive my first result, I [B]feeled devastated because I [C]didn't achieved the score my university [D]has required.'
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! 4 lỗi: received|felt|didn't achieve|required!
items.feedback_wrong: [A]received [B]felt [C]didn't achieve [D]required. Bốn lỗi Simple Past phổ biến nhất!
items.explanation_short: [A]was receive→received. [B]feeled→felt. [C]didn't achieved→didn't achieve. [D]has required→required.
items.ielts_tip: Review: (1)cấu trúc V, (2)bất quy tắc, (3)sau didn't, (4)Perfect trong past context.

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic
